description: Versioned allowlist of machine event codes that may cross the Pino privacy projector in the `event` field. Exact match only; any other value is omitted. Every code passed to a Pino logger call in app/ and lib/ must be declared here, and every declared code must still be emitted (bounded cardinality). See __tests__/lib/security/pino-log-privacy-event-codes.test.ts.
